t.name: Box Canyon Trail
t.description: Box Canyon Trail offers views, elevation, lake access, and rustic camping options. The lake can be reached in four miles, the end of the trail in six. Enjoy peaceful vistas and the calming sounds of Lake Chelan.

t.name: Trail to Dory's Rock
t.description: The trail was made after the fire of 1970, where logging was allowed to remove damaged trees. The loggers created drag roads to remove the logs. These road are still used by hunters, hikers, and animals alike. Named after an old hunter that used to hunt

t.name: Burns Creek Pack Trail
t.description: Accessible from the top of the trail, private entry from the bottom. Suggest people access trail from a different location if entering or exiting from the bottom, do not cross private property. For paper copy, use the Brief USGS Topo map from 1968.

t.name: Old Fox Creek Pack Trail
t.description: Old pack trail from 1968. Accurate above 2800ft, trail may no longer exist in several places. High degree of difficulty.
